interpretation: offline same-recorded-state readout/target accounting only; no closed-loop counterfactual, causality, stability, or novelty claim
prior_evidence_boundary: The Y versus Y+Mrf relation and fixed-W0 comparisons, including early/late windows and axes, are established on TRAIN/training-VAL Teacher B/POS_OFF traces; this script only measures the distinct frozen C5 M110 PCF-on DEV72 paths and makes the squared-energy cross term explicit.

definitions.interval_pair: j=ids[q], k=ids[q+1]; ids are logged valid event indices, every 10 plant steps
definitions.prediction: frozen trained W0^T phi_prev, without online adaptation/beta/output clip
definitions.yM: y0+c; independently checked against the logged delayed_prediction_target_mps2 at k
definitions.phase_partition: 0_5 includes completed intervals ending at t<=5s; 5_20 starts at t>=5s
definitions.units: axis energies are summed squared acceleration errors in (m/s^2)^2; per-interval means are also reported
